description:
Activate Viridian Joiner by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Viridian Joiner.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

uses.name: Viridian Joiner
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater
